The group employs custom-made malware and has been active since late 2024, indicating a persistent and widespread threat.

articles.summary: A critical authentication-bypass vulnerability in cPanel has led to a surge in exploit activity shortly after its disclosure. Researchers suggest there may have been zero-day exploitation occurring for at least a month, posing a significant risk to affected servers.

articles.title: North Korea Dominates 2026 Cryptocurrency Thefts, Potentially Aided by AI
articles.summary: North Korean threat actors have significantly increased their cryptocurrency heists, with a large majority of stolen funds now attributed to them. The article suggests that artificial intelligence may be playing a role in the sophistication and frequency of these attacks.

articles.summary: CISA, along with US and international partners, has published a guide to promote the secure adoption of agentic AI. This guidance aims to help organizations implement AI technologies responsibly and mitigate associated risks.

articles.summary: Google is integrating a large AI model into Chrome, sparking an AI arms race in browsers, while Mozilla pushes back. The article also touches on a Linux privilege escalation vulnerability, a UK NCSC warning about 'Mythos', and speculates that AI may signal the end of traditional bug bounties.

articles.title: Copy Fail: Critical Linux Kernel LPE Allows Stealthy Root Access
articles.summary: A critical vulnerability, dubbed Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431), has been discovered in the Linux kernel, enabling stealthy root access. This flaw impacts millions of systems worldwide, posing a significant security risk.

articles.title: Rowhammer Attack Against NVIDIA Chips
articles.summary: A new Rowhammer attack has been demonstrated that allows for complete control of machines running NVIDIA GPUs. This vulnerability, affecting NVIDIA's Ampere generation cards, significantly escalates the potential impact of Rowhammer attacks.

articles.summary: A ransomware negotiator has pleaded guilty to secretly collaborating with a ransomware gang while negotiating payments for clients. This case reveals a significant conflict of interest and betrayal of trust within the cybersecurity incident response field.

This campaign underscores the use of social engineering and tailored lures by nation-state-linked actors.
